title.hr: Dvije antene zajedno: razmak, faza i zakretanje snopa
title.en: Two antennas together: spacing, phase and steering the beam

concept.hr: Polja se zbrajaju s razlikom puta i faze: faktor niza oblikuje i zakreće snop
concept.en: Fields add by path difference and feed phase: the array factor shapes the beam

summary.hr: Razmak i fazni pomak između antena, do osam njih: bočno i uzdužno zračenje, kardioida, zakretanje snopa, rešetkasti snopovi iznad λ i uži snop s više antena.
summary.en: Spacing and phase step between up to eight elements: broadside, end-fire, a cardioid, a steered beam, grating lobes past λ and a narrower beam with more.
